findings.title: Fallback to the full file list is undocumented after the docblock moved
findings.body: The docblock moved from `fetchWorkspaceFilePaths` to `useWorkspaceFilePaths`, so the exported function now has no comment. Its non-obvious behaviour is the `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` fallback to `/workspace/files`, which drops deleted files and re-shapes the response (lines 2219-2227). A one-line comment there would say why the second request exists. The move is also unrelated churn in this PR.

findings.title: prefetchQuery drops the retry-after-cancel that fetchWorkspaceFiles had
findings.body: `fetchWorkspaceFiles` (lines 2446-2452) refetched once when the first attempt was cancelled. `prefetchQuery` swallows errors and does not retry a cancelled read. The PR relies on prefetch plus the inspector's own `useQuery` to cover this. Please confirm that the Files inspector always mounts a `useQuery` on `sessionWorkspaceFilesQueryOptions`. If the user opens Files, another cancel happens (for example a `cancelQueries` call on the workspace key), and nothing is subscribed, the manifest stays unloaded until a later event.
